title: A softer edge
description: Layered masks turn a sharp surface into a gradual, adjustable blur.
useCase: Soften the edge of decorative media or create a gradual transition behind a floating surface.
reducedMotion: The artwork stays still. The blur control remains usable and updates immediately.
limitations: Eight backdrop-filter layers can be expensive on large surfaces. Keep the region small; browsers without backdrop-filter show sharp artwork.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a rounded pale-mint card of tilted teal and sage bars blurring toward the bottom, above a caption and range slider.
motion: The range slider scales the radius of eight masked backdrop-blur bands that deepen toward the bottom, while the striped artwork bobs and tilts on a 10 s ease-in-out loop.
adapt: The blur is eight `backdropFilter` layers whose overlapping `maskImage` gradients step the radius by index; tune `layers`, `segmentSize`, `intensity` and the `180deg` direction. The SVG bars and `sf-progressive-blur-drift` keyframes are demo artwork; place real media underneath.
